reason: The support is still a single paper (arXiv:2609.03028, 3,553 SWE-chat sessions): late requirements are followed by about twice the invalidation of prior edits, and in a controlled experiment, announcing the requirement in advance did not reduce overwriting. No independent replication or contrary result has been recorded since 2026-09-28. RMD-LATEREQ-001 (fix requirements before implementation via spec-first workflow and plan mode) is a current candidate. Keep unverified.

evidence.summary: About 2x edit invalidation after late requirements; advance notice had no effect; the paper proposes no mitigation.
candidate; spec-first workflow (Spec Kit), plan-mode approval before implementation (official Claude Code costs guidance).
